stemBlocks: A circuit comprising two resistors and two batteries, with negligible internal resistance, is set up as shown in the diagram.
The two junctions in the circuit are labelled X and Y. What are the magnitude and direction of the current in the $3.0 \text{ V}$ battery?

|  | magnitude of current / A | direction of current |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 1.0 | from X to Y |
| B | 2.0 | from X to Y |
| C | 2.25 | from X to Y |
| D | 6.0 | from X to Y |
| E | 1.0 | from Y to X |
| F | 2.0 | from Y to X |
| G | 2.25 | from Y to X |
| H | 6.0 | from Y to X |
